description: This file defines the 'Complex' class that manages complex numbers, including parsing, validation, and mathematical operations related to complex numbers.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A class representing complex numbers with methods for parsing, validation, and mathematical operations, including handling string representations and custom operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Complex object, parsing input as needed to set real, imaginary parts, and suffix.

methods.name: getReal
methods.description: Returns the real part of the complex number.

methods.name: getImaginary
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of the complex number.

methods.name: getSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix ('i' or 'j') of the complex number.

methods.name: isReal
methods.description: Returns true if the complex number has zero imaginary part.

methods.name: isComplex
methods.description: Returns true if the complex number has a non-zero imaginary part.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the complex number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the complex number, invoked when treated as a string.

methods.name: validateComplexArgument
methods.description: Validates or converts an argument into a Complex object, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns a new Complex object with real and imaginary parts swapped.

methods.name: invertImaginary
methods.description: Returns a new Complex object with the imaginary part inverted.

methods.name: invertReal
methods.description: Returns a new Complex object with the real part inverted.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for mathematical functions and operations, redirecting to appropriate static handlers.
